messages:
claire (PMM): kickoff for the benchmark segment of the launch post + companion webinar. goal: a single page that lets engineers quickly see latency vs cost tradeoffs and then play with an embedded sandbox. headline needs to be punchy and technical-friendly. who wants to try options?

jess (copy): options: "Latency you can design for. Costs you can measure." or "Meet the real tradeoff: ms vs $ per 1k tokens." will write a 2-line lede that calls out routing + cache as the levers.

omar (designer): visual plan: interactive hero with a scatter + contour overlay, small control panel (preset: dev/prod/enterprise + payload size slider), and a compact legend. also a static PNG fallback for AMP/feeds. will mock two sizes.

rachel (growth): inbound routing: two CTAs (play sandbox / book lab). track with utm=playbench and utm=booklab. set hidden field `interest=benchmark-sandbox`. for enterprise leads add a checkbox: "I need SLA/Dedicated capacity".

ivan (data): seeding numbers to use in the article:
```
route,latency_p50_ms,cost_per_1k,throughput
stock,210,0.13,160
fastpath,60,0.095,260
quant+cache,38,0.038,110
```
Also prepared p95 series across payload sizes: 256/1024/2048 tokens -> p95 jumps by ~2.2x at 2048 for the stock route. will attach CSV and a small JS generator for contours.

jess (copy): structure suggestion: 1) one-line claim, 2) interactive hero + mini explainer, 3) three scenario cards with numbers (dev/product/infra), 4) brief how-it-works bullets, 5) CTAs + FAQ. keep copy punchy and engineer-forward.

omar (designer): quick chart spec (pseudo):
```
mark: point + contour
encodings: x=latency_p50_ms, y=cost_per_1k, size=throughput, color=route
controls: payload_size slider, preset buttons -> toggles route mix
```
Tooltip: p50, p95, model, cost. will drop figma link in 2 hrs.

ivan (data): small note: for the sandbox, we should let users toggle between p50 and p95 and choose payload length. i'll include a precomputed grid for d3 to keep browser cost low. CSV -> /marketing/assets/bench-sandbox-3234567.csv

rachel (growth): email funnel: sandbox signups -> automated sandbox invite with prepopulated query showing their chosen preset, plus quickstart. booklab -> calendar invite + follow-up checklist PDF. subject line A/B test ideas: A) "See how fast your app could be" B) "How much inference cost can you save?"

statsbot: nightly-bench-202 finished. report: s3://redwood-bench/reports/202/index.html. numbers align with Ivan's CSV within 4%.

claire (PMM): owners: Jess -> hero + scenario copy, Omar -> hero mock + PNG fallback, Ivan -> CSV + contour generator, Rachel -> HubSpot forms + nurture flows. Deadline: assets for review in 24 hours. quick 15m sync tomorrow 9:00am PT to sign off. thanks :rocket:

jess (copy): I'll shoot two headline variants and the 3 scenario microcopy by EOD today.

omar (designer): Figma link: https://figma.com/s/redwood-bench-sandbox (invite pending). PNG fallback dims: 1200x628.

rachel (growth): I'll draft the form and the nurture emails, and wire up utm mapping.

ivan (data): uploading CSV and JS snippet now. watch for drive link.

claire (PMM): perfect. if anyone hits blockers ping here. let's keep the technical detail visible in the post (numbers, csv, tiny snippet) so devs can reuse. final note: include a short FAQ item on quantization quality tradeoffs.
